hypothesis: The reproducible 103/105 memetic basin can be completed by changing at most two nonzero mark coordinates from its best state, yielding a scope-111 DTS that the stochastic search did not sample exactly.
rationale: All three memetic seeds converged to the same internally valid state with only duplicate differences 10 and 21. An exhaustive Hamming-1/Hamming-2 coordinate enumeration over all 35 nonzero mark positions is a small, deterministic follow-up that can settle whether the remaining conflicts are a shallow local repair rather than requiring a new global basin.
expected_information_gain: A validator-accepted result is direct true-objective progress. Exhaustively finding no scope-111 target in this complete finite neighborhood closes this particular 103 basin through two coordinate changes, while a best score above 103 quantifies local escape; neither outcome implies global infeasibility.
method: Compile research_tools/search_dts_memetic_neighborhood.cpp with WSL2 g++ -O3. Starting from the exact 103-unique rows emitted by dts-memetic-conflict-ga-001, enumerate every replacement value 1..111 for each of the 35 nonzero coordinates, then every replacement-value pair for each unordered pair of coordinates. Sort each changed row, reject rows that violate normalization or internal Golomb uniqueness, score the union of all 105 differences, and independently validate any target rows with research_tools/verify_dts.py and research_tools/verify_dts_independent.py.
metric: Exhaustive case counts, internally valid case count, maximum global unique-difference count, and independent validator result
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A complete validator-valid seven-row result with scope<=111 is exactly the frozen true objective. Exhaustive finite-neighborhood coverage and best unique score are local evidence only.

configuration.enumeration: all coordinate replacements including same-row and cross-row pairs, with row sorting after replacement

kill_condition: Stop at the first internally valid target and preserve it for independent validation, or after all one/two-coordinate cases are enumerated. A finite-neighborhood miss is not global infeasibility.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if an independent validator accepts scope<=111

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: exact neighborhood coverage determines whether the new basin is locally repairable

interpretation: The complete declared one/two-coordinate neighborhood was enumerated without a scope-111 target. The best state remained the 103/105 memetic state, and both independent integer verifiers reject it for duplicate differences 10 and 21.
what_was_learned: The reproducible 103 basin has no completion within two nonzero mark-coordinate replacements over the full scope-111 domain. This closes the tested shallow repair neighborhood and does not imply global DTS infeasibility.
recommended_next_action: Close the memetic basin and retain the 103 state only as Level 1 proxy evidence; any further DTS work requires a genuinely different construction or external capability.
repetition_justification: This is a deterministic exhaustive neighborhood around a newly discovered 103 state, not a repeat of the prior clamped-witness repair through three changed rows or the prior stochastic two-mark annealing.
